scientific_integrity.claim_domain: The complete standard-representation Fourier block on \(S_n\) for every \(n\ge4\) and a single full conjugacy class C; counting measure on group and class.
scientific_integrity.computational_evidence: Exact class-Gram and trace-moment checks for every conjugacy class for \(4\le n\le7\), 38 cases, 5904 group elements.
scientific_integrity.proved_limits: Four exact normalized concentration sectors, with full multiplicities and zero sectors, and precise injectivity conditions, by analytic representation-theoretic proof.
scientific_integrity.provenance: Mathematical statements and proof are self-contained; compared primary literature is cited with persistent identifiers. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_integrity.unproved_limits: No corresponding all-class assertion for other irreducible blocks, arbitrary subsets of a conjugacy class, or general unions. Mathematical priority over all historical equivalent orbit-frame descriptions is not established.
